tools.name: token-security_risk-verdict
tools.description: Read a Base token contract and return an evidence-based verdict. Facts, signals, and unavailable checks are separate. No risk score is produced, and absence of a signal is not a safety approval. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/token-security/risk-verdict. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms

tools.name: token-security_honeypot-risk-check
tools.description: Look for observable pause and blacklist indicators in Base bytecode and standard calls. This does not simulate a buy or sell. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/token-security/honeypot-risk-check. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: token-security_ownership-risk-check
tools.description: Read owner(), EIP-1967 proxy slots, and bytecode selectors for mint, pause, and blacklist privileges on Base. Selector presence is not proof the owner can call them. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/token-security/ownership-risk-check. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: token-security_liquidity-risk-assessment
tools.description: Assess Base pool liquidity reported by the public DEX Screener API, including concentration across returned pools. LP lock is not verified. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/token-security/liquidity-risk-assessment. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: token-security_manipulation-signals
tools.description: Report buy, sell, price-change, and volume signals from public DEX Screener data for the largest Base pool. These are feed observations, not proof of manipulation. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/token-security/manipulation-signals. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: token-security_due-diligence-report
tools.description: Combine the Base contract checks and DEX Screener observations into one report for an agent. The report never approves interaction and does not turn missing evidence into a safety claim. Price $0.12 USDC. POST /api/v1/token-security/due-diligence-report. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms

tools.name: token-security_sell-simulation
tools.description: Simulate buy then sell for a Base token via Honeypot.is and return sellable as pass, fail, or not_checked with buy/sell tax when reported. Absence of a honeypot flag is never recorded as pass without a successful simulation. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/token-security/sell-simulation. An unpaid ca

tools.name: token-security_deployer-funding-trace
tools.description: Identify the Base token deployer, walk early inbound funding hops, and report holder concentration clusters. Unknown funding origin is identified=false with origin_label=unknown — not a neutral skip. Price $0.10 USDC. POST /api/v1/token-security/deployer-funding-trace. An unpaid call returns the x40

tools.name: token-security_price-two-source
tools.description: Compare an on-pool DEX Screener USD price (deepest Base pool) with DeFiLlama coins API for base:<token>. The two feeds are independent aggregators; agree=pass can still reflect overlapping underlying pools when both quote the same liquidity. agree is pass, fail, or not_checked; a single source never

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "token-security" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: token-security_risk-verdict, token-security_honeypot-risk-check, token-security_ownership-risk-check · Private data: token-security_risk-verdict, token-security_honeypot-risk-check, token-security_ownership-risk-check, token-security_liquidity-risk-assessment, token-security_manipulation-signals, token-security_due-diligence-report, token-security_sell-simulation, token-security_deployer-funding-trace, token-security_price-two-source · Public sink: token-security_risk-verdict, token-security_honeypot-risk-check, token-security_ownership-risk-check, token-security_liquidity-risk-assessment, token-security_manipulation-signals, token-security_due-diligence-report, token-security_sell-simulation, token-security_deployer-funding-trace, token-security_price-two-source · Destructive: token-security_risk-verdict, token-security_honeypot-risk-check, token-security_ownership-risk-check, token-security_liquidity-risk-assessment, token-security_manipulation-signals, token-security_due-diligence-report, token-security_sell-simulation, token-security_deployer-funding-trace, token-security_price-two-source.
